publicHeading: Keep sponsors visible without cluttering your page.
shortDescription: A seamless scrolling strip for event sponsors, community partners and brand logos — with optional links, scheduling and click reporting.
longDescription: Show sponsors, partners and accreditations in a polished horizontal banner that scrolls continuously or sits in a static grid. Start from a real event example, then tune headings, motion, tile sizes and colours with the same controls you use inside LeadPages.
